choices.content: Line segment \(AB\) and line segment \(BA\) are different line segments
Ray \(AB\) and ray \(BA\) are the same ray
The length of a line can be measured
Line \(AB\) and line \(BA\) are the same line

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct?

solutions.explanation: Line \(AB\) and line \(BA\) represent the same line; line segments \(AB\) and \(BA\) are the same segment; rays \(AB\) and \(BA\) have different endpoints and are not the same ray; the length of a line cannot be measured.
solutions.title: Check notation and defining features
